decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (13_1547 309; received 17/11/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The noise from the plant shall not exceed the levels stated in the Noise Assessment approved with the planning application 01143/78/P11 on 03/12/2014.

Condition : 4 - The existing cycle shelter shall be removed within three months of this approval and, notwithstanding the approved plans, two Sheffield style cycle stands under a canopy no more than 1.8 metres high shall be installed to the north of the re-located air conditioning units adjacent to the rear wall of the shop.
description: Retrospective application for the relocation of approved cycle shelter and plant.
